title: House Rules
pitch: Leon Marsh runs cards in the old signal office and has stopped paying Victor's rake. He says the game's his. Collect.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Folding chairs, a crate of whisky, two spare card tables. He's not running one game. He's running three.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: A tally behind the sun visor. Friday's pot, eleven hundred. A column marked V, left blank.
